author: Gian Casale
text: Justin is the man. Booked a pool party cabana at wet republic and bottle service at marquee. He personally met us at both venues and verified that we were taken care of. Smooth experience

author: Makayla Altfillisch
text: I had my first experience at Jewel… let me say the music, the vibes, the people, etc… ITS PERFECT! I had so much fun!

author: Dillon R.
text: Great service and timely responses!! Definitely recommend their service. Jake was extremely helpful with getting us a table at XS, which allowed us to have a great time for my buddies bachelor party!

author: Florencia L.
text: Justin and Josh are by far the best hosts/concierges in Vegas!!!!! They are amazing! Always taking the best Care Of you and giving you the best service. I have organized my vegas time with them a couple Of times and im looking forward for the next time. This time i went there for the edc weekend with all my girlfriends, We had bottle service at marquee but at the terrace and Josh got us a Great Spot in the main room (no extra charge) :D The table and service at the ebc pool Party was incredible but the Spot that Justin got for us at daylight for disclosure was AMAZING!!!!!!!!!! I always tell my friends about Nokturnal :) they are simply the best in Vegas!!! We had AN INCREDIBLE Vegas ever thanks To them!

author: Frankie D.
text: Although I live in Las Vegas, I'm a stranger to the clubs. My cousins came into town with some friends and they wanted to go to a club. Not knowing where to start I called Justin at NLS. He gave us a variety of places we could go with no cover and with the type of music we liked(mind you we had 12 people in our group). He gave us prices on bottle services and his personal recommendations. He was very patient with us. Our group was fairly indecisive as to where everyone wanted to go. Eventually we went to Marquee and had a great time. Justin was able to get us all in the club with no cover charge which is always nice. Justin is a cool guy that's easy to work with. With me not knowing anything about the Vegas club scene he was a huge help. Without him I know we would've been waiting in long lines and probably would have paid for the cover for a club playing music we don't like. If any of family or friends come in from out of town, I recommend them to Nokturnal Lifestyle.

author: Jonathan C.
text: Sick service and everything is clear when I had to book a table for encore beach club. Easy to contact with fast replies. Made the whole partying process a breeze. A must if you wanna party in Vegas!

author: Mark S.
text: Let me light up another 5 stars for Justin. He helped me coordinate a trip for 11 guys with a wide age and income range. Justin was available and anxious to offer options from lodging to restaurants to entertainment. We worked on plans from weeks before and through the stay. His recommendations were on target and our savings were more than expected.

author: Michael N.
text: So now that I'm recovered from my Vegas trip a couple of weeks ago, I wanted to let people know how great of a time my group had dealing with Justin at Nokturnal. Justin was very straightforward on what we were getting when we purchased a package feom him for a night out at Light Nightclub. He got us a great deal and made sure that everything was taken care of the right way. Justin walked us to our table and made sure we were in good shape before he left us to enjoy our night. No surprises at all and everything went as planned. Anybody who has ever dealt with getting a table knows what kind of shenanigans can put a damper on your night, and we had none of those issues dealing with Justin. Justin even got a great group picture for us which ended up being the only pic of the night. Highly recommended.

author: Neil M.
text: This company is legit. Justin is the man! After arrival I was scared to even try going to a club seeing those long lines with 100+ people waiting in them. Justin made everything simple and easy. I cut the entire line not even wearing a nice shirt and everyone in line was like "whose this guy", needless to say I felt like a boss. Haha, had a real good time at XS for cheap, walked out feeling like the man dropped $150 on red and lost!... Again shout out to justin he's the man! Hell yeah Justin!

author: Nick B.
text: Josh from Nokturnal Lifestlye hooked us up! Had a great time at Omnia Night Club and saved us a ton of money on drinks and our VIP table. He was a really genuine guy that wanted us to have a great time. I highly recommend them!!!

author: Nick H.
text: NLS & took great care of us! We all went out to XS and Justin was a wonderful host. For much less than what we would have paid in line, we got priority access to the club and drink service. Justin was on call if we needed anything. Would highly recommend to friends!

author: Nico V.
text: I recently went to Surrender Nightclub for Twerksgiving to see Diplo recommended by Justin at NLS. He not only put my friends and I on a guest list(even ratio), but also took us to a cabana and introduced to people we would have not been comfortable approaching by ourselves. He was a great host. He was responsive with his texts before and during the night. I respected his honesty due to his accuracy when setting the expectations early on. He didn't promise introductions or a cabana, but he did promise he'd try. I have been burned too many times by hosts that promise the world and don't deliver(Hakkasan host that shall remain nameless). He gave us clear instructions and made sure we met our timelines so we could have the best experience possible. I had a group of 9 guys and 9 girls so it was great to having someone reliable taking care of our night. He made me look like a boss. I recommend Nokturnal Lifestyle to anyone that wants a Vegas host that will be upfront, reliable, responsive, and connected.

author: Rodolfo D.
text: Amazing service! Literally contacted them last minute to get into XS and in less than 30 mins from the first phone call I was inside the club while people waited hours outside in the rain. They have me as a client for life

author: Sheila E.
text: Justin is amazing, I cannot recommend him more. He gave us a seriously deal on a table at LIGHT Marquee and Surrender. 10/5 stars, I am recommending him to all of my friends.

author: Tyler E.
text: Awesome time at Hakkasan at MGM, thanks to Justin we got in no problem, it was an epic night. Thanks again Justin for coming through bro, I'll highly recommend this for anyone

author: Alicia V.
text: Justin at NLS was highly recommended to me by a friend when I was planning my best friends 22nd birthday celebration. I had managed to get a large group of 23 people together and Justin got us hooked up at Surrender Nightclub here in Vegas with a cabana and bottle service! The night went so much better than I expected and everything was perfect. He made the process extremely easy so that we could all enjoy our night to the fullest. My best friend was so happy with the turn out and I owe it all to Justin! I highly recommend him whenever you are planning anything involving Vegas nightlife!

author: Amin G.
text: Amazing Service! Justin did an amazing job helping us put together night out at Hakkasan! Everything was as promised and on time. Not to mention way better prices compared to going through with the club directly. If you are gonna be in Vegas than you will for sure want to call Justin!

author: Angel G.
text: My boy Justin and his brother took care of us for all of our events. As easy as shooting us a price and coordinating every single detail with TAO nightclub and Marquee Day Party and we just showed up. They were always prompt to greet us and show us around. Made our vegas trip super easy.

author: Arthur C.
text: I recently went to Vegas on 2 separate occasions, and Justin at NLS really made things come together perfectly. I've gone to many of the clubs in Vegas through many different hosts throughout the years, but how Justin takes care of you makes things just so easy and worry-free. I think I'll just call Justin every time I plan a trip to Vegas now. First met Justin when I came in the summer 2014 for my now brother-in-law's bachelor party, and was rolling with 25+ guys. First night got the biggest poolside table with a perfect view of Deadmau5. The next night, Zedd was spinning but we didn't want to get a table that night. Didn't have presale tix, sold out. I called Justin, and he walked all of us, the whole horde of guys straight in, NO LINE, and no extra charge other than the cover. Had other guys trickle in throughout the night and Justin walked them in as they came. Importantly, if you just waited in line to pay to get in, you would be restricted to OUTSIDE ONLY, but with Justin walking us in we had FULL ACCESS, no problem. Pretty much the perfect bachelor party weekend and all the guys thought I had some serious hookups at the clubs. This past weekend, 6 of us went to Hakkasan and XS, no line, no problem, no funny business. Tons of people just waiting outside, and we just walk right in. He was really trying hard to get us a comped table at Hakkasan on Friday night, and he almost did, but we just got there too late (needed to be there at 10 but by the time we got there from LA it was past 11). Justin seems like he will always hook it up if he can and is always fast to reply, friendly, and seems really honest. If you just want someone to take care of things for you, skip lines into clubs or getting a table without adding big fees, basically at cost and hassle-free, Justin is your guy. Just make sure you take care of him when he takes care of you...

author: Corey S.
text: My man...Justin. He killed it, that's all I have to say. We had a group of 10 looking for a table at a hip hop club. This is how the process went: Communication Justin was on top of it from the get-go. He recommended two places and said Omnia was the place to be for us. He wanted us set up with a premier table right on the dance floor near the DJ Booth. We went back and forth consistently throughout the day hammering out the details and he was never out of touch. I knew I was getting a response within a minute of texting him. Dude has magic fingers on that phone. He's also not a cheese ball like most of the other people we've worked with in the past. Justin is an easy going guy that wants to act in your best interest to get you what you need. Just a stellar person. Pricing Justin was well below other promoters pricing, and had better table options as well. Very fair in my opinion, and willing to work with you based on your budget. Experience This is what I got excited about. We met Justin at the agreed-upon time outside of Omnia, he had us in front of absolutely everyone and got us in the door FIRST. And the table he got us was right on the money. Right on the floor in the middle of the action, with the best team of servers in the building. It ended up being one of the most epic nights we've had as a group of guys. He checked in with us throughout the night and even into the next day to make sure that everything was up to par for us. It was a VIP experience for us through and through. Justin and his team are going to be our first call the next time we step foot in Vegas, hands down. And he should be yours too. Keep up the good work.

author: Daniel E.
text: Great and outstanding service. I recommend Justin most definitely. He came through for my friends and I at Marquee in the Cosmopolitan. He was quick and accommodating. Can't wait to go back anyone using this service will be in good hands.

author: David L.
text: I've had Justin help me out on two occassions now. Once to get line privileges for a large group at Surrender and another time to help coordinate a cabana at Rehab (Hard Rock). In a business full of dishonesty and guys that are just marking up services you can easily get by going direct, Justin runs an honest business and has the respect of venue hosts across the Strip. Great guy and a solid bet in a city where everything is a gamble.

author: Elliot Y.
text: I recently had Justin and Jay help me out with table service at XS for a bachelor party of 12. I really can't say enough good things about these guys. They're honest, on time and reliable. They have a good grasp on all the hot spots with all the right connections. Ive worked with other promoters in the past but have felt intimidated at times but these guys are genuinely good dudes who want to make an honest living while making sure there customers have a great time. Another great thing is that they were always accessible over phone and text message both leading up to event as well as the night of. They were prompt and professional thorough out. I usually don't leave a ton of reviews but really felt compelled to leave a heart felt one after this trip. Do it guys. Trust me.

author: Elyyse L.
text: Top notch! Justin & Josh hooked it UP for my sisters bachelorette party! We did a table at Drais for 2 Chainz with amazing bottle deals - Josh got us upgraded from a patio table to a table on the balcony over looking the stage which literally made the night! Then we did VIP at Daylight Pool Party Sunday and again Josh got us upgraded from a daybed to a table right in front of the pool. Everything was perfect! Best deals I could find, Up front and no hassles. Best of all, absolutely no waiting in lines (which-- I have waited in a line before at Marquee even when we did do a VIP table). We walked right in with Josh who was super fun and chill and got us all nice and hyped up for the day and night! 100% would use them again! THANK YOU NOKTURNAL!

author: Keith R.
text: My friends and I have been using Justin for the last couple years when visiting Las Vegas. I have dealt with 4 different people now when coming to party in Vegas and I am happy to say once I was introduced to Justin I deleted the other 3 phone numbers. They didn't necessarily do anything wrong but it's what Justin does better. He responds very quickly and truly does look out for you and your group's best interests. And depending on the night he can get you a free upgrade or a surprise thrown in. We have booked Marquee (twice), Jewel, and Omnia all with him in the last 2 years and I have zero complaints. If you are visiting and or partying in Vegas for the first time or had a bad experience with someone else on your last visit I would look no further. He will take the anxiety and difficulty setting up bottle service/ guest lists/ etc away for you. Justin will definitely be getting a text from me and my friends every time we come back to Las Vegas.

author: Lana F.
text: Justin was my contact for the weekend and he is the most responsive industry person I've ever came across with. He made sure we get a good deal for a great table at Marquee. He would text me beck within seconds and was able to answer all my questions (which were a lot!!) clearly and patiently. He went above and beyond for us to get us all the details we wanted. I will definitely contact him again the next time I'm in Vegas. :)

author: Nay J.
text: Everything was great! We used Nokturnal Lifestvle to go Drais on Saturday! We got in free too! Thank you guys!

author: prashanth m.
text: When I took on the responsibilities of planning a guys weekend in Vegas, I didn't know how deep of a hole I would slip into researching options and things to do. From the very first communication with Justin, I felt a huge weight off my shoulders. His communication was just right and he got right on all the activities and made reservations. On things that I was not sure about, he gave me options and more details. We met Justin, the man! in person on Saturday night at the Zouk club where he got us in through the express lane. We had a great time and Overall, when the weekend was over, my buddies complimented me on how it was the best weekend ever. Justin is the buddy you wish you had in Vegas. Reach out to him and just enjoy the action.

author: Rohit R.
text: VEGAS can't get any better Vegas is a party city by itself but Justin just made it a hell lot better for us . It was my 4th trip to Vegas and the last 2 times i was in town was for bachelor parties and Justin took care of everything for us. We were about 25 people and we were all given priority access to all the places that we went including VIP tables. He hooked us up with a party bus and a table by the pool at XS, it was just amazing and the next time we hung out at Marquee at a pool party all day. We all had a very good time and will definitely reach out to Justin the next time we are in Vegas When in Vegas, just call Justin !!

author: Stephanie G.
text: I have to say Justin one of the greatest promoters in Las Vegas. Not only is he quick at responding to text messages but he is so great at recommending and refering you to places. For example, 4 of my girls and I were over in Las Vegas last weekend. Not only did justin assisted with making sure we have a great time in vegas but he went a step further and added us into the late guest list to a pool party at marquee, HE IS AMAZING! I'll defintely keep refering him to my people.
